column1: # The Ubuntu packages the AppImage bundles that LICENSE-001 does not yet let
# ship (PLATFORM-013): a package, a tab, and what it waits on. Each was read
# against what its binary package ships (openspec/specs/legal/debian_licences.tsv,
# debian_readings.tsv); what is left is the policy's (licences.tsv): a licence
# it does not list, or LicenseRef-build-only for a package its row does not
